style.Footer: flex-direction: column; gap: 72px; padding: 96px 100px 36px 100px; background: var(--on-navy-deep); @media(--tablet){ padding: 72px 40px 32px 40px; gap: 56px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 56px 20px 28px 20px; gap: 44px; }
style.Footer top: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 48px; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; }
style.Footer brand: flex-direction: column; gap: 26px; padding: 0px; width: 360px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Footer about: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 24px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68);
style.Newsletter input: flex-grow: 1; padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); font-family: var(--on-sans); font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); line-height: 1.2;
style.Newsletter subscribe: background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%); color: #071F44; font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 16px 22px; border-radius: 0px; line-height: 1.2;
style.Footer columns: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 64px; align-items: flex-start; @media(--tablet){ gap: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 36px; }
style.Col Explore: flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 0px; width: 180px; max-width: 100%;
style.Col Explore title: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-gold-soft); margin-bottom: 4px;
style.Col Explore 1: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); transition: color 0.3s; &:hover{ color: #E2BB6C; }
